rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Low Dose CT (LDCT) for Lung Cancer Screening

criteria.description: Patient age is between 50 and 80 years old
Documented smoking history of at least 20 pack-years
Patient is currently smoking or has quit smoking within the past 15 years

required_documentation: Shared decision-making visit notes documenting pack-years, smoking cessation counseling, and absence of lung cancer signs
rules.review_notes: USPSTF and CMS aligned annual LDCT lung cancer screening criteria.
